definitions.gloss: second class; second grade; second prize
definitions.explanation: The second rank in a graded series—second class of travel or accommodation, second grade of quality, or second prize in a lottery or contest. Composed of {二|に} (two) and {等|とう} (rank, grade).

examples.japanese: くじ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{二等|にとう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{当|あ}たった→当たる：01860_ataru⟧。
examples.english: I won second prize in the raffle.

examples.japanese: {二等|にとう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{賞品|しょうひん}→賞品：21558_shouhin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{旅行券|りょこうけん}→旅行券：28001_ryokouken⟧だ。
examples.english: The second prize is a travel voucher.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{客船|きゃくせん}→客船：16792_kyakusen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一等|いっとう}→一等：28091_ittou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{三等|さんとう}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{客室|きゃくしつ}→客室：21608_kyakushitsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あり→ある：00006_aru⟧、{二等|にとう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧だった。
examples.english: Old passenger ships had cabins from first to third class, and second class was the most popular.

notes:
Ranks pair with the counter suffix {等|とう}: ⟦{一等|いっとう}→一等：28091_ittou⟧ (first), {二等|にとう} (second), {三等|さんとう} (third).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {二等|にとう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{当|あ}たる→当たる：01860_ataru⟧: to win second prize
- {二等|にとう}⟦{賞|しょう}→賞：03227_shou⟧: second prize
- {二等|にとう}{席|せき}: second-class seat

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{一等|いっとう}→一等：28091_ittou⟧: first class; first prize — one rank above
- ⟦{準|じゅん}{優勝|ゆうしょう}→準優勝：04910_junyuushou⟧: runner-up — used for finishing second in a competition, not for a prize tier
